description: This Java class 'JwtTokenVerifier' extends 'OncePerRequestFilter' and handles JWT token verification, including extracting tokens from request headers, validating them, handling refresh tokens, and setting authentication in the security context.

classes.name: JwtTokenVerifier
classes.description: A filter class that verifies JWT tokens in incoming HTTP requests, handles token refresh, and sets authentication context.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the method to process each HTTP request, extract and validate JWT tokens, handle refresh tokens, and set security context.

methods.name: updateResponseWithJwtAndRefreshToken
methods.description: Generates new JWT and refresh tokens, adds refresh token as cookie, and sets authorization header in the response.

methods.name: getAuthentication
methods.description: Creates an Authentication object from username and authorities extracted from JWT claims.

methods.name: getJwsClaims
methods.description: Parses a JWT token and returns its claims.

methods.name: readRefreshTokenMapFromRequest
methods.description: Reads and deserializes the refresh token JSON payload from the HTTP request body.
